title: Qt: Remove various Qt5 compatibility code
description:
Remove all the Qt5 only code guarded by QT_VERSION_CHECKs, and also
some 6.1 and lower code.

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • 412b05d7 - Remove more support for Qt5
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/25234/diffs?diff_id=1833745709&start_sha=95a650b07bc2b100bf46c2a96533398fd0eb22a3)
Rebased what I had written on top of this.  The main difference (now) is removing the USE_qt6 CMake option
